# M1-09 — Forward Engineering Considerations Register

## Labels
`docs`, `research`, `milestone-1`, `priority-medium`

## Milestone
Milestone 1 — Engineering Foundation & Requirements Baseline

## Tasks
- [ ] Identify 5–7 project-specific later-lifecycle concerns (e.g. security, testability, CI, deployment environment, data migration/recovery, observability, scalability, maintainability, operational cost)
- [ ] For each concern, state why it matters now
- [ ] For each concern, state what later decision/activity it will influence
- [ ] For each concern, state what information is still missing
- [ ] For each concern, state the risk of ignoring it
- [ ] Confirm none of these concerns cross into premature implementation/decision-making (see M1 boundaries)
- [ ] Integrate the register into PED v1.0

## Acceptance Criteria
- Exactly 5–7 concerns are listed, each CivicConnect-specific (not copied from Assignment 1 research).
- Each entry has: why-now, downstream influence, missing information, risk-of-ignoring.
- No entry constitutes a final architecture/technology/design decision — deferment is explicit and justified where relevant.
